full_judgment: 3. The relevant facts for disposal of this Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal in short, are that the original owner of the suit land was Troylakkho Nath Mukhapadbay, he died leaving his son Satish Chandra, Jatish Chandra, Motilal, Gopal Chandra, Nepal Chandra and Vupal Chandra as his heirs. Each of those six sons of Troylakkho Nath obtained 65 decimals of land respectively. Nepal Chandra died leaving his two sons Kalipada and Kanaylal as his heir. Vupal Chandra died leaving two minor sons Arun Chandra and Nirmal Kumar as his heir. Satish Chandra sold his own 65 decimals land to his brother Jatish Chandra by a patta deed No.4225/1939. By purchasing 65 decimals of land and by obtaining 65 decimals as heir, Jatish Chandra owned total 1.30 acres of land. Jatish Chandra sold his 1.30 acres of land to one Mansur Bhawali on 13.08.1956 by a registered sale deed No.3729. Sons of Nepal Chandra, Kalidas and Kanaylal sold their 65 decimals land to Mansur Bawali on 27.02.1957 by a registered sale deed No.470. Motilal sold his 65 decimals land to Mansur Bhawali on 19.02.1978 by a registered sale deed No.337. Sons of Vupal Chandra, Arun Chandra and Nirmal Kumar also sold their 65 decimals land to Mansur Bhawali. By dint of above deeds Mansur Bhawali had been owning total 3.90 acres of land. 34 decimals land of State Acquisition (in short, S.A.) Khatian No.275, 1.04 acres land of S.A. Khatian No.276, 1.86 acres land of S.A. Khatian No.278 i.e. total 3.24 acres of land was recorded in the name of Mansur Bawali. Rest 66 decimals land was wrongfully recorded in the name of Jatish Chandra in S.A. Khatian No.277. Mansur Bawali regularly paid rent of S.A. Khatian No.277 and obtained dakhila and he died on 1987 leaving his heir mother, 1(one) wife, 4(four) sons and 1(one) daughter, they are plaintiff Nos.1-4. After that when the heirs of late Mansur Bhawali-the plaintiffs went to pay the rent, Tahshildar informed them that the land is recorded in the name of Government, and, as such, the plaintiffs instituted the instant suit for declaration of their title over the suit land.
